import hashlib
import importlib.util
import inspect
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from types import MethodType, SimpleNamespace

os.environ.update(HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1', TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1', TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM='false', CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
root = Path('/home/moloch/jacobian-lens/research/refit_round_2026-09-07/probe_extension')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('p4_workflow', root / 'workflow.py')
w = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(w)
plan = w.load_plan(root / 'prepared/plan.json')
source_paths = [w.OURO / 'src/ouro_jlens/recurrent.py', w.OURO / 'src/ouro_jlens/evaldata.py', w.REPO / 'jlens/hooks.py', w.REPO / 'jlens/hf.py']
for path in source_paths:
    w.check_identity(path, {'sha256': w.SOURCE_PINS[str(path)]})
tokenizer_names = {'config.json', 'merges.txt', 'special_tokens_map.json', 'tokenizer.json', 'tokenizer_config.json', 'vocab.json'}
tokenizer_files = []
for record in plan['historical_provenance']['model_files']:
    name = record['path'].removeprefix('model_snapshot/')
    if name in tokenizer_names:
        path = w.SNAPSHOT / name
        w.check_identity(path, record)
        tokenizer_files.append(w.identity(path))
w.require(len(tokenizer_files) == len(tokenizer_names), 'tokenizer input inventory')
sys.path[:0] = [str(w.OURO / 'src'), str(w.REPO)]
import torch
import transformers
from ouro_jlens import recurrent, evaldata
w.require(not torch.cuda.is_initialized(), 'CUDA already initialized')
tokenizer = transformers.AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(str(w.SNAPSHOT), trust_remote_code=True, local_files_only=True)
wrapper = SimpleNamespace(tokenizer=tokenizer, input_device='cpu')
wrapper.encode = MethodType(recurrent.OuroLensModel.encode, wrapper)
population = w.rows()
encoded = w.validate_encoded(wrapper, population)
aliases = [{'label': label, 'surface_forms': evaldata.surface_forms(str(label)), 'token_ids': evaldata.single_token_ids(tokenizer, evaldata.surface_forms(str(label)))} for label in w.LABELS]
w.require(len(encoded) == 1224 and all(row['input_ids'][0] == tokenizer.bos_token_id for row in encoded), 'all rows explicit BOS')
w.require(all(row['token_ids'] for row in aliases), 'nonempty aliases')
w.require(all(row['readout_index'] == row['length'] - 1 and row['length'] <= 512 for row in encoded), 'last literal token readout and no truncation')
metadata = w.tokenizer_metadata(tokenizer.init_kwargs)
w.canonical(metadata)
w.require(any(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('type') == 'AddedToken' for value in metadata.values()), 'actual AddedToken serialization exercised')
w.require(not torch.cuda.is_initialized(), 'tokenization initialized CUDA')
for record in tokenizer_files:
    w.check_identity(record['path'], record)
for path in source_paths:
    w.check_identity(path, {'sha256': w.SOURCE_PINS[str(path)]})
proof = {
    'schema': 'p4-tokenizer-preflight-v1', 'status': 'PASS_LOCAL_TOKENIZER_ONLY', 'created_utc': w.utc(),
    'implementation': w.identity(root / 'workflow.py'), 'contract': w.identity(root / 'CONTRACT.md'), 'plan': w.identity(root / 'prepared/plan.json'),
    'runtime': w.runtime_versions(['torch', 'transformers', 'tokenizers', 'numpy']), 'interpreter': sys.executable,
    'tokenizer_inputs': tokenizer_files, 'source_files': [w.identity(path) for path in source_paths],
    'tokenizer_class': str(type(tokenizer)), 'tokenizer_class_source': w.identity(inspect.getfile(type(tokenizer))),
    'tokenizer_init_kwargs': metadata, 'bos_token_id': tokenizer.bos_token_id,
    'encoded': encoded, 'encoded_canonical_sha256': hashlib.sha256(w.canonical(encoded)).hexdigest(),
    'encoded_length_min': min(row['length'] for row in encoded), 'encoded_length_max': max(row['length'] for row in encoded),
    'aliases': aliases, 'aliases_canonical_sha256': hashlib.sha256(w.canonical(aliases)).hexdigest(),
    'checks': ['frozen workflow and contract binding', 'all six local tokenizer input hashes before and after', 'four consumed reference source pins before and after', 'all 1224 native encode calls on CPU', 'every literal prompt retains one explicitly prepended BOS', 'every prompt untruncated', 'last complete literal prompt token readout', 'all 17 candidate alias sets nonempty', 'actual AddedToken metadata JSON serialization', 'CUDA uninitialized before and after'],
    'limits': ['No model constructor, weights load, feature extraction, raw scoring, classifier fitting or network access.', 'Local tokenizer evidence is prospective metadata validation, not GPU execution evidence.'],
    'procedure_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'procedure_source_sha256': w.digest(__file__)
}
w.write_json(root / 'TOKENIZER_PREFLIGHT.json', proof)
print({'status': proof['status'], 'rows': len(encoded), 'lengths': [proof['encoded_length_min'], proof['encoded_length_max']], 'alias_counts': [len(row['token_ids']) for row in aliases], 'proof': w.identity(root / 'TOKENIZER_PREFLIGHT.json')})
